item.title: Jaguars acquire All-Pro safety Jessie Bates III from Falcons in multi-pick trade; Vikings urged to explore QB market
item.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars acquired All-Pro safety Jessie Bates III from the Atlanta Falcons on Monday, sending a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick to Atlanta in exchange.
